    return "upi://pay?" + urlencode({"pa": profile.upi_id, "pn": profile.name, "cu": "INR"}, quote_via=quote, safe="@")


def upi_qr_svg(uri: str) -> Markup:
    svg = segno.make(uri, error="m").svg_inline(scale=1, border=2, omitsize=True, dark="#1f2937")
    return Markup(svg.replace("<svg ", '<svg role="img" aria-label="UPI payment QR code" ', 1))


@dataclass
class Category:
    name: str
    items: list[tuple[int, Product]] = field(default_factory=list)  # (index in profile.products, product)


def group_products(products: list[Product]) -> list[Category]:
    """Main items by category, in first-seen order; items keep their order inside each. Extras are left out."""
    groups: dict[str, Category] = {}
    for i, p in enumerate(products):
        if p.addon:
            continue
        key = p.category.strip() or "Menu"
        groups.setdefault(key.lower(), Category(name=key)).items.append((i, p))
    return list(groups.values())


def extras(products: list[Product]) -> list[tuple[int, Product]]:
    return [(i, p) for i, p in enumerate(products) if p.addon]


def badges(profile: Profile) -> list[str]:
    """Short facts for the top of the page, only from profile data. A missing field = no badge."""
    out = []
    if profile.selling_point.strip():
        out.append(profile.selling_point.strip())
    if profile.min_notice_days == 1:
        out.append("Order 1 day ahead")
    elif profile.min_notice_days > 1:
        out.append(f"Order {profile.min_notice_days} days ahead")
    if profile.pickup_available and profile.delivery_available:
        out.append("Pickup or delivery")
    elif profile.pickup_available:
        out.append("Pickup available")
    elif profile.delivery_available:
        out.append("Delivery available")
    return out


def monogram(name: str) -> str:
    words = [w for w in re.findall(r"[A-Za-z0-9\u0900-\u097F]+", name) if w.lower() not in {"the", "and", "s"}]
    return "".join(w[0] for w in words[:2]).upper() or "•"


def area_is_repeated(profile: Profile) -> bool:
    return bool(profile.area.strip()) and profile.area.strip().lower() in profile.tagline.lower()


def render_site(profile: Profile, *, page: str = "home", order: dict | None = None, form_error: str = "",
                form_values: dict | None = None, preview: bool = False, shop: str = "") -> str:
    """page: 'home' | 'privacy' | 'thanks'. preview=True: the owner's private look at a shop that
    isn't public (banner on top, the order button is off)."""
    uri = upi_uri(profile)
    return _env.get_template("seller.html").render(
        p=profile,
        page=page,
        categories=group_products(profile.products),
        extras=extras(profile.products),
        badges=badges(profile),
        monogram=monogram(profile.name),
        show_area=bool(profile.area.strip()) and not area_is_repeated(profile),
        whatsapp_url=whatsapp_link(profile),
        order_whatsapp_url=order_whatsapp_link(profile, order) if page == "thanks" else None,
        upi=uri,
        upi_qr=upi_qr_svg(uri) if uri else None,
        order=order,
        form_error=form_error,
        form=form_values or {},
        order_token=(form_values or {}).get("order_token") or secrets.token_urlsafe(16),
        preview=preview,
        shop=shop,  # printed as <meta name="lw-shop">: the HTTPS check looks for it
    )

def walk(routes) -> Iterator:
    """Every real route of the app, including those inside included routers."""
    for r in routes:
        inner = getattr(r, "original_router", None)
        if inner is not None:
            yield from walk(inner.routes)
        else:
            yield r


def app_routes(app) -> list[tuple[str, str, object]]:
    """(METHOD, path, route) for every route; a mounted directory is METHOD "MOUNT"."""
    out = []
    for r in walk(app.routes):
        methods = [m for m in (getattr(r, "methods", None) or []) if m not in ("HEAD", "OPTIONS")]
        if not methods:
            out.append(("MOUNT", r.path, r))
        out.extend((m, r.path, r) for m in sorted(methods))
    return out


def gate_calls(route) -> set[str]:
    """Names of every dependency function the route uses (searched through sub-dependencies)."""
    seen: set[str] = set()

    def visit(dep) -> None:
        for d in getattr(dep, "dependencies", []):
            call = getattr(d, "call", None)
            if call is not None:
                seen.add(getattr(call, "__name__", ""))
            visit(d)

    if getattr(route, "dependant", None) is not None:
        visit(route.dependant)
    return seen

"""SQLite tables. Fields are minimal for M0 and will grow per milestone."""

from datetime import UTC, datetime

from sqlmodel import Field, SQLModel


def utcnow() -> datetime:
    return datetime.now(UTC)


class User(SQLModel, table=True):
    """A seller (or the admin). Signs in with an email link; no passwords are stored anywhere."""

    id: int | None = Field(default=None, primary_key=True)
    email: str = Field(unique=True, index=True)  # lowercase, trimmed; proven at first sign-in
    status: str = "pending"  # pending (practice only) | approved (real launches) | suspended | deleted
    role: str = "seller"  # seller | admin
    status_reason: str = ""  # shown to the user when rejected / suspended
    created_at: datetime = Field(default_factory=utcnow)
    last_login_at: datetime | None = None


class LoginToken(SQLModel, table=True):
    """A single-use emailed link (sign in, or confirm deleting the account). Only the SHA-256
    of the token is stored, so a copy of the database can't be used to sign in."""

    id: int | None = Field(default=None, primary_key=True)
    token_hash: str = Field(unique=True, index=True)
    email: str = Field(index=True)
    purpose: str = "login"  # login | delete_account
    visitor: str = Field(default="", index=True)  # hashed IP that asked (rate limit)
    expires_at: datetime
    used_at: datetime | None = None
    created_at: datetime = Field(default_factory=utcnow)


class UserSession(SQLModel, table=True):
    """Server-side session. The cookie holds a random token; only its SHA-256 is stored."""

    visitor: str = Field(default="", index=True)  # hashed IP (limit), never the IP itself

    visitor: str = ""  # hashed client IP that approved it (daily launch limit)

    created_at: datetime = Field(default_factory=utcnow)

    approved_by: str
    used_at: datetime | None = None
    created_at: datetime = Field(default_factory=utcnow)

"""Launch API: name ideas, plan (approval card), approve, step log, resume, practice "I bought it".

Every route needs the business's owner key (or admin). Practice businesses always
use the fake world (`for_business`). When a launch finishes, the launch checks run.
"""

import json
from collections.abc import Callable
from typing import Annotated, Literal

from fastapi import APIRouter, BackgroundTasks, Depends, HTTPException, Request, Response
from pydantic import BaseModel, Field
from sqlalchemy.engine import Engine
from sqlmodel import Session, func, select

from app import audit
from app.agents.claude_client import FALLBACK_NAMES_NOTE, Claude, ClaudeBudgetExceeded
from app.agents.executor import reset_for_resume, run_plan
from app.agents.launch_check import AlreadyChecking, run_checks
from app.agents.namer import NamerError, find_names, namer_fixture
from app.agents.planner import PlanError, active_plan, build_plan, plan_out
from app.agents.policy import policy_check
from app.agents.reader import Profile
from app.config import Settings, get_settings
from app.db import get_session
from app.integrations import Integrations, for_business, get_integrations, get_practice_integrations
from app.models import Approval, Business, Plan, utcnow
from app.routers.businesses import get_claude
from app.safety.access import ActorDep, launches_today, require_business_access, require_plan_access, visitor_id
from app.selfcheck import fixture_on_real_server
from app.sites.hosts import is_public, site_url

router = APIRouter(prefix="/api", tags=["launch"])
IntegFor = Callable[[Business | Plan], Integrations]  # chosen by the object's own `practice` flag


def integrations_for(server: Annotated[Integrations, Depends(get_integrations)],
                     practice: Annotated[Integrations, Depends(get_practice_integrations)]) -> IntegFor:
    """FastAPI dependency: pick the fake world or the real one for a given business."""
    return lambda b: for_business(b, server, practice)


NOT_APPROVED = ("Your account is waiting for approval, so you can practise for now. "
                "We'll email you as soon as you can launch for real.")
SUBDOMAINS_ONLY = "Shops live at an address under ours for now. Using your own domain comes later."


def live_shops(session: Session) -> int:
    return session.exec(select(func.count()).select_from(Business).where(
        Business.status == "live", Business.practice == False)).one()  # noqa: E712


@router.get("/businesses/{business_id}/names")
def name_ideas(response: Response, b: Annotated[Business, Depends(require_business_access)],
               session: Annotated[Session, Depends(get_session)],
               claude: Annotated[Claude, Depends(get_claude)],
               integ_for: Annotated[IntegFor, Depends(integrations_for)]) -> list[dict]:
    integ = integ_for(b)
    profile = Profile.model_validate_json(b.profile_json)
    try:
        quotes = find_names(claude, integ.availability, profile, fixture=namer_fixture(b.description))
    except NamerError as e:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=502, detail=str(e)) from e
    except ClaudeBudgetExceeded as e:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=503, detail="Our assistant has reached today's limit. Please try again tomorrow.") from e
    except NotImplementedError as e:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=501, detail="Checking real website names isn't switched on yet. "
                            "You can launch on the free address for now.") from e
    audit.record(session, actor="namer", action="name_ideas", target=f"business:{b.id}", result="ok",
                 business_id=b.id, detail=", ".join(q.domain for q in quotes))
    if getattr(claude, "fell_back", False):
        response.headers["X-Assistant-Note"] = FALLBACK_NAMES_NOTE
        audit.record(session, actor="namer", action="claude_fallback", target=f"business:{b.id}", result="ok",
                     business_id=b.id, detail="live Claude unavailable or daily cap reached; used saved sample names")
    return [{"domain": q.domain, "price_usd": q.price_usd} for q in quotes]


class PlanRequest(BaseModel):

@router.post("/plans/{plan_id}/approve")
def approve_plan(body: ApproveRequest, request: Request, background: BackgroundTasks,
                 plan: Annotated[Plan, Depends(require_plan_access)],
                 actor: ActorDep,
                 settings: Annotated[Settings, Depends(get_settings)],
                 session: Annotated[Session, Depends(get_session)],
                 claude: Annotated[Claude, Depends(get_claude)],
                 integ_for: Annotated[IntegFor, Depends(integrations_for)]) -> dict:
    if plan.status != "draft":
        raise HTTPException(status_code=409, detail="This plan was already approved.")
    running = active_plan(session, plan.business_id)
    if running is not None:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=409, detail="Another launch is already running for this business.")
    visitor, admin = visitor_id(request), actor.is_admin
    if not admin and launches_today(session, visitor) >= settings.visitor_launches_per_day:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=429, detail="You've launched several shops today already. "
                            "Please come back tomorrow to launch another one.")
    b = session.get(Business, plan.business_id)
    integ = integ_for(plan)

    if not plan.practice:
        # A real launch puts a shop on the public internet under our name. Checked again here, at the
        # moment of approval: the account, the certificate budget, and the go-live policy check.
        if not actor.approved or b.guest_hash or plan.mode != "sandbox":
            raise HTTPException(status_code=403, detail=NOT_APPROVED)
        if not (b.status == "live" and not b.practice) and live_shops(session) >= settings.max_live_shops:
            raise HTTPException(status_code=409, detail="We've reached the number of live shops we can host this week. "
                                "Nothing was changed. Please try again in a few days.")
        if b.paused:
            raise HTTPException(status_code=409, detail="This shop is paused by our team, so it can't be launched right now.")
        if b.review != "cleared" and not integ.fake and fixture_on_real_server(settings):
            # Fail closed: with saved Claude answers the policy check would always say OK, so on a server that
            # launches real shops every real launch waits for the team (Team page: "Looks fine").
            b.review, b.review_reason = "held", HELD_FIXTURE
            session.add(b)
            session.commit()
            audit.record(session, actor="policy", action="policy_check", target=f"business:{b.id}", result="held",
                         business_id=b.id, user_id=actor.user_id, detail="fixture mode on a real server: team review")
            raise HTTPException(status_code=409, detail=f"{HELD_FIXTURE} Nothing was launched. "
                                "We'll email you when our team has looked at it.")
        if b.review != "cleared":  # "cleared" = the team already looked
            verdict = policy_check(claude, Profile.model_validate_json(b.profile_json))
            b.review, b.review_reason = ("ok", "") if verdict.ok else ("held", verdict.reason)
            session.add(b)
            session.commit()
            audit.record(session, actor="policy", action="policy_check", target=f"business:{b.id}",
                         result="ok" if verdict.ok else "held", business_id=b.id, user_id=actor.user_id,
                         detail=f"by {verdict.by}: {verdict.reason}"[:300])
            if not verdict.ok:
                raise HTTPException(status_code=409, detail=f"{verdict.reason} Nothing was launched. "
                                    "We'll email you when our team has looked at it.")
        if b.practice:  # from here on the shop is real: old practice results no longer count
            b.practice, b.status = False, "draft"
            session.add(b)
            session.commit()

    if plan.mode == "full":
        # Re-check the price now: never approve a different amount than the card showed.
        if not integ.godaddy.is_owned(plan.zone):
            quote = integ.availability.check([plan.zone])[0]
            if not quote.available or quote.price_usd is None or float(quote.price_usd) > plan.total_cost_usd:
                raise HTTPException(status_code=409, detail="The price or availability changed. Please review the plan again.")
        clash = session.exec(select(Business).where(Business.domain == plan.zone, Business.id != b.id,
                                                    Business.practice == b.practice)).first()
        if clash is not None:
            raise HTTPException(status_code=409, detail="That name is already used by another business here.")
        b.domain = plan.zone  # from now on the domain is "in the app's database" for this business
        session.add(b)
        if plan.total_cost_usd > 0:
            session.add(Approval(business_id=b.id, plan_id=plan.id, action="buy_domain", target=plan.zone,
                                 amount_usd=plan.total_cost_usd, approved_by=body.approved_by))
    session.add(Approval(business_id=b.id, plan_id=plan.id, action="launch", target=plan.site_host,
                         amount_usd=plan.total_cost_usd, approved_by=body.approved_by))
    plan.status, plan.visitor, plan.approved_at = "approved", ("" if admin else visitor), utcnow()
    session.add(plan)
    session.commit()
    audit.record(session, actor="owner", action="approve_plan", target=plan.site_host, result="ok",
                 business_id=b.id, user_id=actor.user_id,
                 detail=f"plan #{plan.id}, {'practice' if plan.practice else 'REAL'}, ${plan.total_cost_usd:.2f}, by {body.approved_by}")
    _start(background, session, settings, integ, claude, plan)
    return {"ok": True, "plan_id": plan.id}

    """Practice mode only: pretend the owner bought the domain on godaddy.com, then resume.

    b = session.get(Business, plan.business_id)

    if not integ.fake or not plan.practice:

    r"weapons?|guns?|firearms?|ammunition|fireworks|firecrackers|prescription|steroids?|narcotics?|cannabis|ganja|weed|"
    r"lottery|betting|gambling|casino|crypto\w*|bitcoin|forex|loans?|escort)\b", re.I)

@router.post("/plans/{plan_id}/approve")
def approve_plan(body: ApproveRequest, request: Request, background: BackgroundTasks,
                 plan: Annotated[Plan, Depends(require_plan_access)],
                 actor: ActorDep,
                 settings: Annotated[Settings, Depends(get_settings)],
                 session: Annotated[Session, Depends(get_session)],
                 claude: Annotated[Claude, Depends(get_claude)],
                 integ_for: Annotated[IntegFor, Depends(integrations_for)]) -> dict:
    if plan.status != "draft":
        raise HTTPException(status_code=409, detail="This plan was already approved.")
    running = active_plan(session, plan.business_id)
    if running is not None:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=409, detail="Another launch is already running for this business.")
    visitor, admin = visitor_id(request), actor.is_admin
    if not admin and launches_today(session, visitor) >= settings.visitor_launches_per_day:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=429, detail="You've launched several shops today already. "
                            "Please come back tomorrow to launch another one.")
    b = session.get(Business, plan.business_id)
    integ = integ_for(plan)

    if not plan.practice:
        # A real launch puts a shop on the public internet under our name. Checked again here, at the
        # moment of approval: the account, the certificate budget, and the go-live policy check.
        if not actor.approved or b.guest_hash or plan.mode != "sandbox":
            raise HTTPException(status_code=403, detail=NOT_APPROVED)
        if not (b.status == "live" and not b.practice) and live_shops(session) >= settings.max_live_shops:
            raise HTTPException(status_code=409, detail="We've reached the number of live shops we can host this week. "
                                "Nothing was changed. Please try again in a few days.")
        if b.paused:
            raise HTTPException(status_code=409, detail="This shop is paused by our team, so it can't be launched right now.")
        if b.review != "cleared" and not integ.fake and fixture_on_real_server(settings):
            # Fail closed: with saved Claude answers the policy check would always say OK, so on a server that
            # launches real shops every real launch waits for the team (Team page: "Looks fine").
            b.review, b.review_reason = "held", HELD_FIXTURE
            session.add(b)
            session.commit()
            audit.record(session, actor="policy", action="policy_check", target=f"business:{b.id}", result="held",
                         business_id=b.id, user_id=actor.user_id, detail="fixture mode on a real server: team review")
            raise HTTPException(status_code=409, detail=f"{HELD_FIXTURE} Nothing was launched. "
                                "We'll email you when our team has looked at it.")
        if b.review != "cleared":  # "cleared" = the team already looked
            verdict = policy_check(claude, Profile.model_validate_json(b.profile_json))
            b.review, b.review_reason = ("ok", "") if verdict.ok else ("held", verdict.reason)
            session.add(b)
            session.commit()
            audit.record(session, actor="policy", action="policy_check", target=f"business:{b.id}",
                         result="ok" if verdict.ok else "held", business_id=b.id, user_id=actor.user_id,
                         detail=f"by {verdict.by}: {verdict.reason}"[:300])
            if not verdict.ok:
                raise HTTPException(status_code=409, detail=f"{verdict.reason} Nothing was launched. "
                                    "We'll email you when our team has looked at it.")
        if b.practice:  # from here on the shop is real: old practice results no longer count
            b.practice, b.status = False, "draft"
            session.add(b)
            session.commit()

    if plan.mode == "full":
        # Re-check the price now: never approve a different amount than the card showed.
        if not integ.godaddy.is_owned(plan.zone):
            quote = integ.availability.check([plan.zone])[0]
            if not quote.available or quote.price_usd is None or float(quote.price_usd) > plan.total_cost_usd:
                raise HTTPException(status_code=409, detail="The price or availability changed. Please review the plan again.")
        clash = session.exec(select(Business).where(Business.domain == plan.zone, Business.id != b.id,
                                                    Business.practice == b.practice)).first()
        if clash is not None:
            raise HTTPException(status_code=409, detail="That name is already used by another business here.")
        b.domain = plan.zone  # from now on the domain is "in the app's database" for this business
        session.add(b)
        if plan.total_cost_usd > 0:
            session.add(Approval(business_id=b.id, plan_id=plan.id, action="buy_domain", target=plan.zone,
                                 amount_usd=plan.total_cost_usd, approved_by=body.approved_by))
    session.add(Approval(business_id=b.id, plan_id=plan.id, action="launch", target=plan.site_host,
                         amount_usd=plan.total_cost_usd, approved_by=body.approved_by))
    plan.status, plan.visitor, plan.approved_at = "approved", ("" if admin else visitor), utcnow()
    session.add(plan)
    session.commit()
    audit.record(session, actor="owner", action="approve_plan", target=plan.site_host, result="ok",
                 business_id=b.id, user_id=actor.user_id,
                 detail=f"plan #{plan.id}, {'practice' if plan.practice else 'REAL'}, ${plan.total_cost_usd:.2f}, by {body.approved_by}")
    _start(background, session, settings, integ, claude, plan)
    return {"ok": True, "plan_id": plan.id}

Rendered from the saved sample profiles (tests/fixtures/claude/reader_*.json), so they need no
database row and no sign-in. Every page is labelled "Demo shop: orders here are not real", and the

import json
from functools import cache
from pathlib import Path

from fastapi import APIRouter, HTTPException, Request
from fastapi.responses import HTMLResponse

from app.agents.reader import Profile
from app.sites.orders import OrderInvalid, parse_order_form
from app.sites.render import render_site

router = APIRouter(tags=["demo"])
FIXTURES = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2] / "tests" / "fixtures" / "claude"
DEMOS = {"meera": "reader_meera_cakes", "imran": "reader_tailor", "sunita": "reader_tiffin_service"}
HEADERS = {"X-Robots-Tag": "noindex"}


@cache
def demo_profile(name: str) -> Profile:
    if name not in DEMOS:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404)
    profile = Profile.model_validate(json.loads((FIXTURES / f"{DEMOS[name]}.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8")))
    # Never point a demo at a real person's phone, WhatsApp or UPI ID, even if a sample gains one later.
    return profile.model_copy(update={"phone": "", "whatsapp": "", "upi_id": "", "upi_display_name": ""})

"""S10.5 §3: the owner's Orders page: status (owner only, audited), WhatsApp to the customer, counts, email."""

from urllib.parse import parse_qs, unquote, urlsplit

import pytest
from sqlmodel import Session, select

from app.models import AuditEvent, Order
from app.sites.orders import STATUS_STEPS, can_move, customer_whatsapp_link
from tests.conftest import publish, sign_in
from tests.test_m3_launch import meera


def place(shopper, name="Priya", phone="9876543210", token="a" * 20):
    form = {"customer_name": name, "customer_phone": phone, "qty_0": "1", "order_token": token}
    r = shopper.post("/order", data=form, headers={"host": "meera.localhost"})
    assert r.status_code == 200, r.text


@pytest.fixture
def shop(client, new_client, engine):
    sign_in(client, "owner@example.org")
    biz = meera(client)
    publish(engine, biz["id"])
    place(new_client())
    return biz


def only_order(engine) -> Order:
    with Session(engine) as s:
        return s.exec(select(Order)).one()


def test_owner_sees_orders_with_full_phone_and_whatsapp(client, shop):
    rows = client.get(f"/api/businesses/{shop['id']}/orders").json()
    assert len(rows) == 1
    o = rows[0]
    assert o["status"] == "new" and o["next_statuses"] == ["confirmed", "cancelled"]
    assert o["customer_phone"] == "9876543210"
    assert o["whatsapp_url"].startswith("https://wa.me/919876543210?text=")
    assert o["tel_url"] == "tel:+919876543210"
    assert client.get("/api/businesses").json()[0]["new_orders"] == 1


def test_status_walks_forward_and_is_audited(client, shop, engine):
    oid = only_order(engine).id
    url = f"/api/businesses/{shop['id']}/orders/{oid}/status"
    for step in ("confirmed", "paid", "done"):
        r = client.post(url, json={"status": step})
        assert r.status_code == 200 and r.json()["status"] == step
    assert client.post(url, json={"status": "cancelled"}).status_code == 409  # done is final
    assert client.get("/api/businesses").json()[0]["new_orders"] == 0
    with Session(engine) as s:
        rows = s.exec(select(AuditEvent).where(AuditEvent.action == "order_status")).all()
    assert [r.detail.split(": ")[1] for r in rows] == ["new -> confirmed", "confirmed -> paid", "paid -> done"]
    assert all("9876543210" not in (r.detail + r.target) for r in rows)  # the phone never reaches the audit log


@pytest.mark.parametrize("to", ["done", "paid", "new", "shipped"])
def test_illegal_jumps_are_refused(client, shop, engine, to):
    oid = only_order(engine).id
    r = client.post(f"/api/businesses/{shop['id']}/orders/{oid}/status", json={"status": to})
    assert r.status_code in (409, 422)
    assert only_order(engine).status == "new"


def test_transition_table():
    assert can_move("new", "confirmed") and can_move("confirmed", "done") and can_move("paid", "cancelled")
    assert not can_move("new", "done") and not can_move("cancelled", "new") and not can_move("done", "paid")
    assert STATUS_STEPS["done"] == () and STATUS_STEPS["cancelled"] == ()


def test_only_the_owner_sees_and_changes_status(client, shop, engine, new_client):
    oid = only_order(engine).id
    other = new_client()
    sign_in(other, "other@example.org")
    meera(other, "other-shop")
    url = f"/api/businesses/{shop['id']}/orders/{oid}/status"
    assert other.get(f"/api/businesses/{shop['id']}/orders").status_code == 404
    assert other.post(url, json={"status": "confirmed"}).status_code == 404
    # someone else's order id under your OWN shop is 404 too
    own = other.get("/api/businesses").json()[0]["id"]
    assert other.post(f"/api/businesses/{own}/orders/{oid}/status", json={"status": "confirmed"}).status_code == 404
    assert new_client().post(url, json={"status": "confirmed"}).status_code == 401
    assert only_order(engine).status == "new"


def test_test_orders_are_hidden_and_cannot_be_changed(client, shop, engine):
    with Session(engine) as s:
        o = s.exec(select(Order)).one()
        o.is_test = True
        s.add(o)
        s.commit()
        oid = o.id
    assert client.get(f"/api/businesses/{shop['id']}/orders").json() == []
    assert client.get("/api/businesses").json()[0]["new_orders"] == 0
    assert client.post(f"/api/businesses/{shop['id']}/orders/{oid}/status", json={"status": "confirmed"}).status_code == 404


@pytest.mark.parametrize("name", ["Asha & Ravi", "Zoë 🎂 Sharma", "Mary  Ann", "R&D#1 ?x=1"])
def test_whatsapp_links_are_encoded(name):
    o = Order(business_id=1, customer_name=name, customer_phone="+91 98765-43210", ref="LW-ABCD2345", total_inr=1250)
    url = customer_whatsapp_link("Cakes & Co. 🍰", o)
    parts = urlsplit(url)
    assert parts.netloc == "wa.me" and parts.path == "/919876543210"
    assert " " not in url and "&" not in parts.query.split("=", 1)[1] and "#" not in url
    text = parse_qs(parts.query)["text"][0]
    assert text.startswith(f"Hi {name.split()[0]}, this is Cakes & Co. 🍰.")
    assert "LW-ABCD2345" in text and "₹1,250" in text
    assert unquote(parts.query.split("=", 1)[1]) == text


def test_no_whatsapp_link_for_a_bad_number():
    assert customer_whatsapp_link("Shop", Order(business_id=1, customer_name="A", customer_phone="12345")) is None


def test_order_email_has_ref_links_and_orders_page(client, shop, mailer):
    mail = next(m for m in mailer.sent if "New order" in m["subject"])
    body = mail["body"]
    assert "LW-" in body and "tel:+919876543210" in body and "https://wa.me/919876543210?text=" in body
    assert f"/#/b/{shop['id']}/orders" in body

cat > golive.py <<'PY'
"""S10.5 go-live checklist: what a real shop needs before "Launch for real".

Drafts and practice launches are never blocked by this. Only a real launch is (routers/launch.py, at plan time and
again at approval). Each item is plain words for the owner. Owner-confirmed steps are stored with the exact value
that was confirmed, so changing the WhatsApp number or the UPI ID / name quietly undoes the confirmation.
"""

from dataclasses import asdict, dataclass

from sqlmodel import Session

from app.agents.reader import Profile, indian_mobile
from app.models import Business
from app.safety.access import owner_emails


@dataclass
class Item:
    key: str
    label: str  # what is needed, in plain words
    done: bool
    hint: str = ""  # what to do next when it isn't done


def upi_key(profile: Profile) -> str:
    return f"{profile.upi_id}|{profile.upi_display_name.strip()}"


def whatsapp_confirmed(b: Business, profile: Profile) -> bool:
    return bool(profile.whatsapp) and b.wa_confirmed == profile.whatsapp


def upi_confirmed(b: Business, profile: Profile) -> bool:
    return bool(profile.upi_id and profile.upi_display_name.strip()) and b.upi_confirmed == upi_key(profile)


def checklist(session: Session, b: Business) -> list[Item]:
    p = Profile.model_validate_json(b.profile_json)
    priced = [x for x in p.products if not x.addon and x.price_inr > 0]
    has_way = p.pickup_available or p.delivery_available
    way_ok = has_way and (not p.delivery_available or bool(p.delivery_areas.strip())) \
        and (not p.pickup_available or bool(p.area.strip()))
    return [
        Item("email", "A verified sign-in email for orders and alerts", bool(owner_emails(session, b.id)) and not b.guest_hash,
             "Sign in with your email."),
        Item("shop", "Shop name, shop address and at least one item with a price",
             bool(p.name.strip() and b.subdomain and priced), "Add an item with its price."),
        Item("whatsapp", "Your WhatsApp number, checked by you", whatsapp_confirmed(b, p) and indian_mobile(p.whatsapp) is not None,
             "Add your WhatsApp number, tap “Test this number”, then “Yes, that's me”." if p.whatsapp
             else "Add your WhatsApp number."),
        Item("upi", "Your UPI ID and the name your UPI app shows, checked by you", upi_confirmed(b, p),
             "Do the ₹1 UPI test and confirm the name matches." if p.upi_id and p.upi_display_name.strip()
             else "Add your UPI ID and the name your UPI app shows."),
        Item("fulfilment", "How customers get their order: pickup (your area) and/or delivery (areas and fee)", way_ok,
             "Choose pickup or delivery." if not has_way
             else "Add the areas you deliver to." if p.delivery_available and not p.delivery_areas.strip()
             else "Add your area or locality for pickup."),
        Item("rules", "Your working days and hours (and how many days' notice you need)", bool(p.hours.strip()),
             "Add your working days and hours."),
        Item("agreements", "You confirmed you make or sell these yourself, and accepted the Terms",
             b.own_goods_at is not None and b.terms_at is not None, "Tick both boxes and save."),
        Item("preview", "You looked at your shop's preview at least once", b.previewed_at is not None,
             "Tap “Preview my shop”."),
    ]


def missing(session: Session, b: Business) -> list[Item]:
    return [i for i in checklist(session, b) if not i.done]


def refusal(items: list[Item]) -> str:
    return "Before your shop can go live, please finish: " + "; ".join(i.label.lower() for i in items) + "."


def out(session: Session, b: Business) -> dict:
    items = checklist(session, b)
    return {"ready": all(i.done for i in items), "items": [asdict(i) for i in items]}

"""S10.5 go-live checklist: what a real shop needs before "Launch for real".

Drafts and practice launches are never blocked by this. Only a real launch is (routers/launch.py, at plan time and
again at approval). Each item is plain words for the owner. Owner-confirmed steps are stored with the exact value
that was confirmed, so changing the WhatsApp number or the UPI ID / name quietly undoes the confirmation.
"""

from dataclasses import asdict, dataclass

from sqlmodel import Session

from app.agents.reader import Profile, indian_mobile
from app.models import Business
from app.safety.access import owner_emails


@dataclass
class Item:
    key: str
    label: str  # what is needed, in plain words
    done: bool
    hint: str = ""  # what to do next when it isn't done


def upi_key(profile: Profile) -> str:
    return f"{profile.upi_id}|{profile.upi_display_name.strip()}"


def whatsapp_confirmed(b: Business, profile: Profile) -> bool:
    return bool(profile.whatsapp) and b.wa_confirmed == profile.whatsapp


def upi_confirmed(b: Business, profile: Profile) -> bool:
    return bool(profile.upi_id and profile.upi_display_name.strip()) and b.upi_confirmed == upi_key(profile)


def checklist(session: Session, b: Business) -> list[Item]:
    p = Profile.model_validate_json(b.profile_json)
    priced = [x for x in p.products if not x.addon and x.price_inr > 0]
    has_way = p.pickup_available or p.delivery_available
    way_ok = has_way and (not p.delivery_available or bool(p.delivery_areas.strip())) \
        and (not p.pickup_available or bool(p.area.strip()))
    return [
        Item("email", "A verified sign-in email for orders and alerts", bool(owner_emails(session, b.id)) and not b.guest_hash,
             "Sign in with your email."),
        Item("shop", "Shop name, shop address and at least one item with a price",
             bool(p.name.strip() and b.subdomain and priced), "Add an item with its price."),
        Item("whatsapp", "Your WhatsApp number, checked by you", whatsapp_confirmed(b, p) and indian_mobile(p.whatsapp) is not None,
             "Add your WhatsApp number, tap “Test this number”, then “Yes, that's me”." if p.whatsapp
             else "Add your WhatsApp number."),
        Item("upi", "Your UPI ID and the name your UPI app shows, checked by you", upi_confirmed(b, p),
             "Do the ₹1 UPI test and confirm the name matches." if p.upi_id and p.upi_display_name.strip()
             else "Add your UPI ID and the name your UPI app shows."),
        Item("fulfilment", "How customers get their order: pickup (your area) and/or delivery (areas and fee)", way_ok,
             "Choose pickup or delivery." if not has_way
             else "Add the areas you deliver to." if p.delivery_available and not p.delivery_areas.strip()
             else "Add your area or locality for pickup."),
        Item("rules", "Your working days and hours (and how many days' notice you need)", bool(p.hours.strip()),
             "Add your working days and hours."),
        Item("agreements", "You confirmed you make or sell these yourself, and accepted the Terms",
             b.own_goods_at is not None and b.terms_at is not None, "Tick both boxes and save."),
        Item("preview", "You looked at your shop's preview at least once", b.previewed_at is not None,
             "Tap “Preview my shop”."),
    ]


def missing(session: Session, b: Business) -> list[Item]:
    return [i for i in checklist(session, b) if not i.done]


def refusal(items: list[Item]) -> str:
    return "Before your shop can go live, please finish: " + "; ".join(i.label.lower() for i in items) + "."


def out(session: Session, b: Business) -> dict:
    items = checklist(session, b)
    return {"ready": all(i.done for i in items), "items": [asdict(i) for i in items]}

def report(b: Annotated[Business, Depends(require_business_access)], actor: ActorDep,
           settings: Annotated[Settings, Depends(get_settings)],
           session: Annotated[Session, Depends(get_session)],
           integ_for: Annotated[IntegFor, Depends(integrations_for)]) -> dict:
    admin = actor.is_admin
    practice = b.practice or integ_for(b).fake  # results from the pretend world are always labelled
    plan = latest_launched_plan(session, b.id)
    latest_plan = session.exec(select(Plan).where(Plan.business_id == b.id, Plan.practice == b.practice)
                               .order_by(Plan.id.desc())).first()
    run_row = session.exec(select(CheckRun).where(CheckRun.business_id == b.id, CheckRun.trigger.in_(OWNER_RUNS))
                           .order_by(CheckRun.id.desc())).first()
    run = run_out(session, run_row) if run_row and plan else None
    proven = proof.summary(session, run)  # adds each check's hops + state ("proven" / "needs_you" / "failed")
    ready, title, left = headline(plan, latest_plan, run, practice)

    def last(trigger: str) -> dict | None:
        r = session.exec(select(CheckRun).where(CheckRun.business_id == b.id, CheckRun.trigger == trigger,
                                                CheckRun.status == "done").order_by(CheckRun.id.desc())).first()
        return {"at": iso(r.finished_at), "passed": r.passed} if r else None

    info_row = session.exec(select(CheckRun).where(CheckRun.business_id == b.id, CheckRun.status == "done")
                            .order_by(CheckRun.id.desc())).first()
    info = json.loads(info_row.info_json) if info_row else {}
    events = session.exec(select(AuditEvent).where(AuditEvent.business_id == b.id)
                          .order_by(AuditEvent.id.desc()).limit(AUDIT_LIMIT)).all()
    # A practice launch's own name is pretend (maybe someone else's real site): link the practice address instead.
    site = (f"https://{plan.site_host}/" if plan and plan.mode == "full" and not b.practice
            else site_url(b.subdomain, settings) if b.subdomain else None)
    return {
        "business": {"id": b.id, "name": b.name, "site_url": site, "has_owner_email": bool(owner_emails(session, b.id)),
                     "practice": b.practice, "public": is_public(b) and not b.paused},
        "plan": {"id": plan.id, "mode": plan.mode, "site_host": plan.site_host, "mailbox": plan.mailbox}
        if plan else ({"id": latest_plan.id, "mode": latest_plan.mode, "site_host": latest_plan.site_host,
                       "mailbox": latest_plan.mailbox} if latest_plan else None),
        "practice": practice,
        "ready": ready, "headline": title, "left": left, "run": run, "proof": proven,
        "launch": launch_out(plan or latest_plan),
        "monitoring": {"enabled": settings.monitor_enabled, "every_minutes": QUICK_MINUTES,
                       "last_quick": last("monitor_quick"), "last_daily": last("monitor_daily"),
                       "cert_days_left": info.get("cert_days_left"), "domain_days_left": info.get("domain_days_left")},
        # Renewals (S10): only for a launched shop; dates from the pretend world are labelled by `practice`.
        "renewals": renewals.card(settings, plan.mode, plan.zone, info) if plan and b.status == "live" else None,
        "audit": [{"at": iso(e.created_at), "actor": e.actor, "action": e.action, "target": e.target,
                   "result": e.result, "detail": e.detail} for e in events],
        "admin": admin,
        "demo_fault": b.demo_fault if admin else None,
    }

# Build log — how LaunchWitness was built with Claude Code

One entry per Claude Code session, newest last. This is what judges read to understand the process; the full transcripts are in the combined replay at `/build`.

## Template (copy for each session)

```
### Session N — YYYY-MM-DD — <short title>
- Goal: <milestone + acceptance criteria targeted>
- Asked Claude to: <1–2 lines>
- Claude built: <files/features>
- I changed / rejected: <what the human decided or corrected>
- Result: <ACs passed, tests, what works now>
- Next: <one line>
```

---

### Session 0 — 2026-11-14 — Ideation and spec
- Goal: settle the idea and plan before writing code.
## 9a. Accounts and tenancy (session 9F)

- **Guest practice.** "Try it" needs no account: an anonymous cookie owns a practice workspace (pretend GoDaddy, never public, deleted after 24 hours).
- **Sign in by emailed link.** No passwords. The link carries 32 random bytes, only its SHA-256 is stored, it works once for 15 minutes, and only the "Sign in" button (a POST) uses it, so mail scanners opening the link change nothing. Same answer whether or not the address has an account. Limits per address and per IP. Signing in keeps the guest's shops (up to the limit). There is no other "claim" mechanism.
- **Sessions.** `__Host-lw_session`: Secure, HttpOnly, SameSite=Lax, Path=/, no Domain (host-only), so shop subdomains never receive it. New id at every sign-in; 14-day sliding expiry; log out; log out everywhere; suspension ends every session at once. CSRF: Origin check + a token derived from the cookie on every change.
- **Tenancy.** Every business route goes through one gate; the ownership filter is part of the database query; another owner's shop answers 404. Shoppers never sign in.
- **Team approval during the beta.** New accounts are *pending* (practice only) until the team approves them. The admin is the `ADMIN_EMAIL` user; `ADMIN_TOKEN` stays for the command line only.
- **Limits.** 3 shops per account; a daily cap on describes (Claude calls) that deleting shops doesn't reset; **at most `MAX_LIVE_SHOPS` (40) live shops**, because Let's Encrypt issues about 50 new certificates per registered domain per week and every shop subdomain needs its own.

-| **CSRF** | `safety/request_guard.py`: every POST/PUT/PATCH/DELETE on `/api` needs an Origin (or Referer) equal to the app's origin. A request that carries a cookie also needs `X-CSRF-Token`, an HMAC of that cookie that only our pages can read (from `/api/auth/me`). `SameSite=Lax` cookies. | Phase 2 tests (wrong Origin, missing token, a token from another cookie). The e2e suite sends real browser fetches through Caddy. |

-| **XSS in seller content** | Seller sites: Jinja2 with autoescape; profile values sit only in text and quoted attributes, never in a script. The React app never uses `dangerouslySetInnerHTML`. | `test_s10_xss.py`: a hostile string in **every** free-text profile field, every product field, the customer's order fields and the refused-order form.
